Not qualified: DSpark at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with native KV. Confidence-allocated batches compute all five drafter heads and score only computed target rows through mapped sampling. Only unallocated uniform depth-three batches of 3-8 items compute three heads. On 2026-10-28, compact allocation resolved a 1.91% request-throughput gain for coding at four streams and 256 outputs, with no resolved regression across coding/chat at four/eight streams and 256 outputs or four streams and 1024 outputs; all used TP4 native KV and temperature 1.0. The adopted fixed-batch GPU smoke on 2026-10-28 passed at 12, 32 and 65 computed rows with greedy and fixed-seed equality of logits, proposals, per-request acceptance and committed state. GPU exactness evidence ends at the tested width of 65; widths 66-192 have CPU coverage only. Widths above 64 rows remain unqualified for timing. Qualification requires AR and speculative arms, exact greedy equality, the declared speculative-verification bounds and GSM8K at least 193 of 200 in each arm. Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and scheduler-selected shared-prefix anchors aligned to 64 tokens, bitwise equal to the full schedule. DSpark prefill batches commit projections and overlaps per-layer Engram gathers by default. Prepared gathers also overlap TP4 native-KV single-item DMA prefill at 512-8192 rows; unsupported row services, media and taps retain synchronous gathers. Prefill runs the tbt budget at a 750 ms decode cadence target with adaptive timing cuts; on 2026-10-30 the adaptive cap resolved gains against off in collapse share and gaps over 1 s in the C16 prefill-saturated and burst cells, kept the C8 long-append cost within the accepted tolerance, and matched off's output tokens, answers and logprobs bit for bit (docs/serving-profiles.md#adaptive-timing-cut-adoption).
